identity.promise: An ordered inspection strip moves beneath one stable focus station; the selected frame arrives without reorder, teleport, or disorienting perspective.
identity.antiMotion: Focus Strip is not Quiet Carousel, a draggable gallery, a filmstrip river, a coverflow, or a dim-the-neighbours card scroller. It never changes source order, duplicates a hidden loop deck, snaps the selected item into place, tilts cards for spectacle, or uses source brightness/filtering as selection.
identity.topology: ordered horizontal strip or portrait inspection column with one reading station
identity.focusGrammar: serial focus station; neighbours retain documentary context
identity.finaleGrammar: selected frame settles at station or exact strip seam
